title: Detailed lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M50 8 C50 8, 38 8, 38 18 L38 22 L42 22 L42 18 C42 13, 46 12, 50 12 C54 12, 58 13, 58 18 L58 22 L62 22 L62 18 C62 8, 50 8, 50 8 Z' fill='#c8a832' stroke='#e8d060' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Top cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='32' height='5' rx='2' fill='#d4b33c' stroke='#f0d860' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Top decorative dome -->
  <path d='M36 27 L36 30 L64 30 L64 27 Z' fill='#b89a2e' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Top rim -->
  <rect x='32' y='30' width='36' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#d4b33c' stroke='#f0d860' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Glass body -->
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='32' height='36' rx='2' fill='#ffdd44' stroke='#ffe888' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#ffaa00' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.9'/>
  
  <!-- Flame -->
  <path d='M50 42 C47 46, 45 50, 47 54 C48 56, 50 57, 50 57 C50 57, 52 56, 53 54 C55 50, 53 46, 50 42 Z' fill='#ff6600'/>

  <!-- Vertical frame bars on glass -->
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='2' height='36' fill='#b89a2e'/>
  <rect x='64' y='34' width='2' height='36' fill='#b89a2e'/>
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='2' height='36' fill='#b89a2e' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Horizontal frame bar on glass (middle) -->
  <rect x='34' y='50' width='32' height='1.5' fill='#b89a2e' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom rim -->
  <rect x='32' y='70' width='36' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#d4b33c' stroke='#f0d860' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom decorative base -->
  <path d='M36 74 L36 77 L64 77 L64 74 Z' fill='#b89a2e' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom cap -->
  <rect x='38' y='77' width='24' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#d4b33c' stroke='#f0d860' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom finial -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='83' r='2.5' fill='#e8d060'/>
  
  <!-- Light rays -->
  <line x1='20' y1='48' x2='28' y2='50' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='56' x2='28' y2='54' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='48' x2='80' y2='50' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='56' x2='80' y2='54' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Side decorative scrollwork -->
  <path d='M34 38 C30 38, 28 42, 30 46' fill='none' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M66 38 C70 38, 72 42, 70 46' fill='none' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M34 62 C30 62, 28 58, 30 54' fill='none' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M66 62 C70 62, 72 58, 70 54' fill='none' stroke='#d4b33c' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
